description: This file defines functions and types for parsing, validating, and applying semantic version filters, including component-specific constraints, using the Masterminds/semver library.

methods.name: MustParseSemVerFilter
methods.description: Parses a semantic version filter string and panics if invalid, returning a SemVerFilter function.

methods.name: ParseSemVerFilter
methods.description: Parses a filter string into a SemVerFilter function that applies component-specific or general version constraints.

methods.name: ValidateAndCleanupSemVerConstraint
methods.description: Validates a semver constraint string and returns it or an error if invalid.
